title: Concept: Dependency declared with range notation
description: build.gradle declares a version in `[1.0,2.0)` form, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a version in `[1.0,2.0)` form.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through build.gradle (gradle).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a version in `[1.0,2.0)` form.
